description: The ranking with maximality off can tie, and then the canonical order T picks the first reading whose terminator the report names. p and q tie under greedy, since they close different constituents. T puts p first, by its lower production number, so the report names T after y, not U after v (engine §4, §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T U
%rule text p | q
%rule p y [T] B
%rule q v [U] B
%rule y A | A B
%rule v A | A B
